messages:
maya: Heads up — noticed RSS creep on kvstore during long-context sessions (10k+ tokens). Looks like eviction runs but memory doesn't return. repro attached.

oliver: Can you paste the minimal repro? I can try on my local perf rig.

maya: repro command: `./tools/kv_stress --model=gptx --tokens=12000 --sessions=50 --evict-interval=30s > /tmp/kv-repro.log`\nflamegraph: /tmp/kv-flame.svg

sara: quick grep of the dump shows repeated small entries with shifted offsets. Example: expected index 0x1a0 -> tag at 0x1a0, but tag landed at 0x1ac repeatedly. That misalignment would make free list not match.

ranjit: could be pack/unpack endian/alignment in the page header. Any pattern on context length when it first shows up?

maya: triggers once a session crosses ~4096 tokens. Seen on both 8k and 16k models but earlier for wider kv pages. log excerpt: `KV_HDR seq=9876 expected_seq=9875 page_start=0x7fff1a20 page_slot=0x1ac` — the seq mismatch is suspicious.

oliver: instrumented eviction counters: `kv.evictions=120, kv.tombstones=1180, kv.free_pages=8` — tombstones rising but free_pages not increasing. That aligns with mis-tagged freed pages.

maya: theory: when we append a new chunk that straddles a 16-byte boundary, our slot rotation math does `(base + len) & ~0xF` somewhere which can push the slot pointer by a few bytes, causing subsequent lookups to fetch the wrong tag (off-by-4). If tag != expected, lookup returns stale block from previous request.

sara: can you paste the small hex dump?\n```
00007fffa1a20: 0f 0a 00 00  12 34 56 78  aa bb cc dd  ee ff 00 11
00007fffa1a30: 22 33 44 55  66 77 88 99  aa aa aa aa  bb bb bb bb
```
here the marker bytes shift by 4 across writes.

ranjit: I will bisect across the recent page/rotation changes. suspect commit d3f9a1b that optimized continuous-batch packing. Will open an experimental branch.

dev-bot: deploy-bot: Canary roll at 2024-11-02T14:03:05Z -> rolled back to rev `main@c1b2` due to increased mem usage alert :warning:

oliver: quick local patch: force-align slots with `page_start = (page_start + ALIGN - 1) & ~(ALIGN - 1)` before writing header. Re-ran stress for 10 minutes, tombstones stabilized, free_pages returned. Not a full fix but promising.

maya: can we add a unit test that writes deliberately misaligned fragments and then validates free-list integrity? Also add a long-context integration test to catch growth over 1h runs.

ranjit: opening PR #3421 with alignment fix + unit tests + an integration stress job config. Will include a small fuzz harness for different alignment offsets.

oliver: ran benchmarks on the branch: tail latency unchanged, throughput -1.2% in worst-case microbench; acceptable. Will run larger perf sweep overnight.

ci-bot: CI: PR #3421 — linux-x86: ✅, macos: ✅, aarch64: ❌ (memcpy alignment assertion). Marking for follow-up.

sara: note for rollout: we should gate the change behind a feature flag for private deployments until aarch64 memcpy issue is sorted.

maya: thanks all. assigning postmortem + follow-up checks: add metric `kv.free_corruptions` and add an alert for monotonically increasing tombstones without free_pages increase. :thumbsup:

oliver: confirmed repro after patch is gone locally. will coordinate canary tomorrow once aarch64 fix lands.
